{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows and column names
df_head = sales_df.head()
columns = sales_df.columns.tolist()

# Display the unique values in the 'status' column
status_unique = sales_df['status'].unique()

# Display the unique values in the 'order_type' column
order_type_unique = sales_df['order_type'].unique()

# Check for the revenue column
revenue_columns = [col for col in columns if 'revenue' in col.lower() or 'amount' in col.lower() or 'price' in col.lower()]

# Return all findings
(df_head, columns, status_unique, order_type_unique, revenue_columns)"}
